description: Fork of exp319 (MinimalGPT + RoPE, 23.2 M, val_bpb @ 8K = 1.5468) doubling device_batch_size 8 -> 16 and total_batch_size 4096 -> 8192. Identical hyperparams otherwise. Directly compares vanilla transformer's batch-size sensitivity against the LUT-LM finding (exp326 -> exp327: Δ=−0.0991 from doubling batch). If vanilla also drops ~0.1 bpb, the batch-size lever is general (not LUT-specific); if vanilla drops far less, the LUT-LM batch-sensitivity hypothesis (sparse per-token gradients in STE training) is confirmed.
